title: DAY 6 — LESSON 6: SUPPORTING NEW AND LESS-EXPERIENCED STAFF

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of supporting new employees?
options: To complete all their work permanently
To help them develop competence, confidence and accountability
To make them dependent on experienced staff

questions.prompt: A new employee asks a reasonable question about a procedure. What should an experienced colleague do?
options: Explain the procedure respectfully and confirm understanding
Mock the employee for not knowing

questions.prompt: What should happen when a new employee has not demonstrated competence in a safety-sensitive procedure?
options: Allow independent work to build confidence
Ask another new employee to supervise
Arrange appropriate training or supervision before independent performance
Sharing approved procedures and helping colleagues learn
Excluding new employees from operational updates

questions.prompt: What does the GUIDE method stand for?
options: Greet, Understand, Instruct, Develop and Encourage
Guess, Undermine, Ignore, Discourage and Exclude
Give orders, Use criticism, Insult, Demand and Embarrass
